note: Known errors of local train runs (R12.12). Autonomy is never written here: kedb.mjs computes it from `outcomes`. Add an entry only once its cause is known.

entries.cause: The offline shim v4 stands in for a package that is not installed on this machine (BRIEF-CODE-14, Known limits); the code under test never ran.
entries.workaround: Not a code failure. Rerun in the other runner (V4=browser) or count it as owed to the Mac run, where the package is installed.

entries.cause: A unified pipeline ran with its remark/rehype plugins stubbed by the offline shim, so it has no compiler.
entries.workaround: Same as shim-stubbed-package: owed to the Mac run.

entries.match: ^Cannot assign to read only property '.+' of object '\[object Module\]'$
entries.cause: The test assigns to an ES module export; native ESM namespaces are read-only in the Node shim, while vitest's transform allows it.
entries.workaround: Check it in real vitest before calling it a bug; a test that needs it should use vi.mock or vi.spyOn on an object export.

entries.cause: The test's MSW server comes from a setup file whose package (msw) is not installed offline.
A real-time test timeout on a shared machine (load average around 45 on 2 CPUs).
entries.workaround: Rerun the file alone before trusting the failure (flake.mjs rerun).

entries.match: ^ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'src/i18n/locales/[\w-]+\.json'$
entries.cause: The test reads the old one-file-per-locale layout; train 4 moved the locales into per-domain folders (src/i18n/locales/<lang>/<domain>.json).
entries.workaround: Read the per-domain files (or the loader) in the test.
